name: CL Intraday Reaction to EIA Petroleum Inventory — With Fade, Settlement & Overnight Analysis
description: Measures how crude oil (CL) futures react to the weekly EIA petroleum inventory report released at 10:30 AM ET on Wednesdays. Part 1: Computes average absolute price moves at 1, 5, 15, and 30 minutes after the release with fade analysis (how often the initial 5-min move reverses by 30 min). Part 2: Compares CL settlement window behavior (2:00–2:30 PM ET) on EIA Wednesdays vs all other trading days. Part 3: Compares overnight/pre-market range (6:00 PM – 9:00 AM ET, capturing Asian and European sessions) on EIA Wednesdays vs non-EIA days — event count, avg range %, median range %, and max range %.
source:
# =============================================================================
# CRUDE OIL INTRADAY REACTION TO EIA WEEKLY PETROLEUM INVENTORY REPORT
# =============================================================================
# EIA Weekly Petroleum Status Report releases at 10:30 AM ET on Wednesdays.
# Measures absolute price moves at 1, 5, 15, and 30 minutes after release.
# Chart 1: Avg absolute move by time window (1, 5, 15, 30 min)
# Chart 2: Distribution of 5-min post-release returns
# Table:   Summary of avg absolute moves + event count
# =============================================================================

# === DATA SOURCE (1Min bars) ===
src = market_data_source()()

# === CONTINUOUS CONTRACT ===
cont = futures_continuation(s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased, s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment, i_offset=0)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)
close = cont.c
high = cont.h
low = cont.l
open_price = cont.o

# === EIA DAY DETECTION (Wednesdays at 10:30 AM ET) ===
bar_idx = index()
day_of_week = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.day_of_week)(bar_idx)
is_wednesday = day_of_week == 2

# === SESSION WINDOWS (release at 10:30 AM ET) ===

# 1-Min window: 10:30-10:31
w_1m = session_window(session=Session(start='10:30', end='10:31', tz='America/New_York'))(open_price, high, low, close)

# 5-Min window: 10:30-10:35
w_5m = session_window(session=Session(start='10:30', end='10:35', tz='America/New_York'))(open_price, high, low, close)

# 15-Min window: 10:30-10:45
w_15m = session_window(session=Session(start='10:30', end='10:45', tz='America/New_York'))(open_price, high, low, close)

# 30-Min window: 10:30-11:00
w_30m = session_window(session=Session(start='10:30', end='11:00', tz='America/New_York'))(open_price, high, low, close)

# === WINDOW RETURNS (open-to-close of each window) ===
r_1m = ((w_1m.close - w_1m.open) / w_1m.open) if w_1m.closed else 0
r_5m = ((w_5m.close - w_5m.open) / w_5m.open) if w_5m.closed else 0
r_15m = ((w_15m.close - w_15m.open) / w_15m.open) if w_15m.closed else 0
r_30m = ((w_30m.close - w_30m.open) / w_30m.open) if w_30m.closed else 0

# === ABSOLUTE MOVES ===
abs_1m = abs(r_1m)
abs_5m = abs(r_5m)
abs_15m = abs(r_15m)
abs_30m = abs(r_30m)

# === ALIGNED SERIES (all latched to w_30m.closed so they fire on the same bar) ===
latched_abs_1m = valuewhen(occurrence=0)(w_1m.closed, abs_1m)
latched_abs_5m = valuewhen(occurrence=0)(w_5m.closed, abs_5m)
latched_abs_15m = valuewhen(occurrence=0)(w_15m.closed, abs_15m)
latched_r_5m = valuewhen(occurrence=0)(w_5m.closed, r_5m)

# Direction for event marker
latched_r_1m = valuewhen(occurrence=0)(w_1m.closed, r_1m)
latched_r_15m = valuewhen(occurrence=0)(w_15m.closed, r_15m)

# Wednesday-filtered absolute moves for bar chart
bar_abs_1m = where(w_30m.closed and is_wednesday, latched_abs_1m)
bar_abs_5m = where(w_30m.closed and is_wednesday, latched_abs_5m)
bar_abs_15m = where(w_30m.closed and is_wednesday, latched_abs_15m)
bar_abs_30m = where(w_30m.closed and is_wednesday, abs_30m)

# 5-min return for histogram (directional, not absolute)
hist_r_5m = where(w_30m.closed and is_wednesday, latched_r_5m)

# Direction label for event marker
dir_label = where(w_30m.closed and is_wednesday, latched_r_1m)

# Event count
eia_count = where(w_30m.closed and is_wednesday, 1.0)

# === EVENT MARKER HELPERS ===
em_abs_1m = where(w_30m.closed and is_wednesday, latched_abs_1m)
em_abs_5m = where(w_30m.closed and is_wednesday, latched_abs_5m)
em_abs_15m = where(w_30m.closed and is_wednesday, latched_abs_15m)
em_abs_30m = where(w_30m.closed and is_wednesday, abs_30m)
em_r_30m = where(w_30m.closed and is_wednesday, r_30m)

# =============================================================================
# REPORTS
# =============================================================================

# --- Summary Table: Avg Absolute Moves + Event Count ---
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='EIA Release — Avg Absolute Move by Window',
        row_size=1,
        col_size=5,
        row_headers=['Average'],
        col_headers=['1-Min Abs Move', '5-Min Abs Move', '15-Min Abs Move', '30-Min Abs Move', 'Event Count'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3, grid_color=Color.Blue),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3, grid_color=Color.Blue),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3, grid_color=Color.Blue),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3, grid_color=Color.Blue),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat)
        ]
    ),
    category='EIA Intraday'
)(bar_abs_1m, bar_abs_5m, bar_abs_15m, bar_abs_30m, eia_count)

# --- Chart 1: Average Absolute Price Move by Window ---
xy_bars(
    title='CL Average Absolute Move Scales With Time After EIA Release',
    category='EIA Intraday',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    data_labels=True,
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=3,
    y_axis_label='Avg Absolute Move',
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='1 Min', color=Color.Blue),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='5 Min', color=Color.Blue),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='15 Min', color=Color.Indigo),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='30 Min', color=Color.Indigo)
    ])
)(bar_abs_1m, bar_abs_5m, bar_abs_15m, bar_abs_30m)

# --- Chart 2: Distribution of 5-Min Post-Release Returns ---
histogram(
    title='Distribution of 5-Min Returns After EIA Release',
    category='EIA Intraday',
    bins=30,
    x_axis_label='5-Min Return',
    y_axis_label='Frequency',
    x_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    fill_color=Color.Blue,
    show_analytics=True,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ])
)(hist_r_5m)

# --- Event Markers ---
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='EIA Weekly Inventory Release',
        icon=Icon.BarChart2Icon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat, table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Hero, title='30-Min Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='1-Min Abs Move', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='5-Min Abs Move', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='15-Min Abs Move', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='30-Min Abs Move', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3)
        ]
    )
)(is_wednesday, em_r_30m, em_abs_1m, em_abs_5m, em_abs_15m, em_abs_30m)

# =============================================================================
# FADE ANALYSIS: Does the 5-min move reverse by the 30-min mark?
# =============================================================================
# Fade = 5-min direction reverses by 30 min (up→down or down→up)
# Hold = 5-min direction sustained through 30 min

is_eia = w_30m.closed and is_wednesday

# 5-min direction flags on EIA bars
is_5m_up = is_eia and (latched_r_5m > 0)
is_5m_dn = is_eia and (latched_r_5m < 0)

# 30-min return conditional on 5-min direction
ret_30m_when_up = where(is_5m_up, r_30m)
ret_30m_when_dn = where(is_5m_dn, r_30m)

# Fade flags: 1.0 if direction reversed, 0.0 if held (Mean = fade rate)
fade_when_up = where(is_5m_up, 1.0 if r_30m < 0 else 0.0)
fade_when_dn = where(is_5m_dn, 1.0 if r_30m > 0 else 0.0)

# Hold flags: complement of fade (Mean = hold rate)
hold_when_up = where(is_5m_up, 1.0 if r_30m >= 0 else 0.0)
hold_when_dn = where(is_5m_dn, 1.0 if r_30m <= 0 else 0.0)

# --- Fade Summary Table ---
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Fade Analysis — 5-Min Direction vs 30-Min Outcome',
        row_size=2,
        col_size=4,
        row_headers=['5-Min Up', '5-Min Down'],
        col_headers=['Events', 'Fade Rate', 'Hold Rate', 'Avg 30-Min Return'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1, grid_color=Color.Red),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1, grid_color=Color.Green),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3, grid_color=Color.Blue),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1, grid_color=Color.Red),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1, grid_color=Color.Green),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3, grid_color=Color.Blue)
        ]
    ),
    category='Fade Analysis'
)(ret_30m_when_up, fade_when_up, hold_when_up, ret_30m_when_up, ret_30m_when_dn, fade_when_dn, hold_when_dn, ret_30m_when_dn)

# --- Chart 3: Avg 30-Min Return by 5-Min Direction ---
xy_bars(
    title='CL 30-Min Return Splits by Initial 5-Min Direction After EIA',
    category='Fade Analysis',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    data_labels=True,
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=3,
    y_axis_label='Avg 30-Min Return',
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ]),
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='5-Min Up', color=Color.Blue),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='5-Min Down', color=Color.Indigo)
    ])
)(ret_30m_when_up, ret_30m_when_dn)

# =============================================================================
# SETTLEMENT WINDOW ANALYSIS: 2:00–2:30 PM ET — EIA Wed vs Non-EIA Days
# =============================================================================
# Compares CL behavior in the settlement window on EIA Wednesdays vs all other days.
# Metrics: (1) High-low range as % of open, (2) Realized volatility (sum of squared
# 1-min returns), (3) Avg absolute 1-min return within the window.
# =============================================================================

# === Settlement Session Window (2:00-2:30 PM ET) ===
settle_w = session_window(session=Session(start='14:00', end='14:30', tz='America/New_York'))(open_price, high, low, close)

# === 1-Min Returns (bar-by-bar, used for intra-window stats) ===
ret_1m = (close - (close >> 1)) / (close >> 1)
ret_1m_sq = ret_1m * ret_1m
abs_ret_1m = abs(ret_1m)

# === Rolling aggregates over 30 bars (settlement window length) ===
# Capture at window close to get stats for exactly the settlement window
rv_30bar = sum(period=30)(ret_1m_sq)
avg_abs_ret_30bar = ma(period=30, type=MAType.sma)(abs_ret_1m)

# === Settlement Window Metrics (latched at window close) ===
settle_range_pct = ((settle_w.high - settle_w.low) / settle_w.open) if settle_w.closed else 0
settle_rv = rv_30bar if settle_w.closed else 0
settle_avg_abs = avg_abs_ret_30bar if settle_w.closed else 0

# === Split by EIA Wednesday vs Non-EIA ===
is_eia_wed = settle_w.closed and is_wednesday
is_non_eia = settle_w.closed and (is_wednesday == False)

# EIA Wednesday metrics
eia_range_pct = where(is_eia_wed, settle_range_pct)
eia_rv = where(is_eia_wed, settle_rv)
eia_avg_abs = where(is_eia_wed, settle_avg_abs)

# Non-EIA day metrics
non_eia_range_pct = where(is_non_eia, settle_range_pct)
non_eia_rv = where(is_non_eia, settle_rv)
non_eia_avg_abs = where(is_non_eia, settle_avg_abs)

# === Settlement Window Summary Table ===
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Settlement Window (2:00–2:30 PM ET) — EIA Wed vs Non-EIA Days',
        row_size=2,
        col_size=4,
        row_headers=['EIA Wednesday', 'Non-EIA Day'],
        col_headers=['Events', 'Avg Range %', 'Avg Realized Vol', 'Avg Abs 1-Min Ret'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3, grid_color=Color.Blue),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=6, grid_color=Color.Blue),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=4, grid_color=Color.Blue),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3, grid_color=Color.Slate),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=6, grid_color=Color.Slate),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=4, grid_color=Color.Slate)
        ]
    ),
    category='Settlement Window'
)(eia_range_pct, eia_range_pct, eia_rv, eia_avg_abs, non_eia_range_pct, non_eia_range_pct, non_eia_rv, non_eia_avg_abs)

# === Chart: Avg Range % in Settlement Window — EIA Wed vs Non-EIA ===
xy_bars(
    title='CL Settlement Window Range Is Wider on EIA Wednesdays',
    category='Settlement Window',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    data_labels=True,
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=3,
    y_axis_label='Avg High-Low Range (% of Open)',
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='EIA Wednesday', color=Color.Blue),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Non-EIA Day', color=Color.Slate)
    ])
)(eia_range_pct, non_eia_range_pct)

# =============================================================================
# OVERNIGHT / PRE-MARKET RANGE ANALYSIS: 6:00 PM ET – 9:00 AM ET
# =============================================================================
# Captures Asian & European session activity before NY open.
# Compares high-low range (% of overnight open) on EIA Wednesdays vs non-EIA days.
# =============================================================================

# === Overnight Session Window (6:00 PM prior day – 9:00 AM same day) ===
overnight_w = session_window(session=Session(start='18:00', end='09:00', tz='America/New_York'))(open_price, high, low, close)

# === Overnight Range % (high-low as % of window open) ===
overnight_range_pct = ((overnight_w.high - overnight_w.low) / overnight_w.open) if overnight_w.closed else 0

# === Day-of-week at overnight close (9:00 AM bar) ===
is_wed_at_close = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.day_of_week)(index()) == 2

# === Split by EIA Wednesday vs Non-EIA ===
is_eia_overnight = overnight_w.closed and is_wed_at_close
is_non_eia_overnight = overnight_w.closed and (is_wed_at_close == False)

eia_overnight_range = where(is_eia_overnight, overnight_range_pct)
non_eia_overnight_range = where(is_non_eia_overnight, overnight_range_pct)

# === Overnight Summary Table ===
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Overnight Range (6 PM – 9 AM ET) — EIA Wed vs Non-EIA Days',
        row_size=2,
        col_size=4,
        row_headers=['EIA Wednesday', 'Non-EIA Day'],
        col_headers=['Events', 'Avg Range %', 'Median Range %', 'Max Range %'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3, grid_color=Color.Blue),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3, grid_color=Color.Blue),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3, grid_color=Color.Blue),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3, grid_color=Color.Slate),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3, grid_color=Color.Slate),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3, grid_color=Color.Slate)
        ]
    ),
    category='Overnight Range'
)(eia_overnight_range, eia_overnight_range, eia_overnight_range, eia_overnight_range, non_eia_overnight_range, non_eia_overnight_range, non_eia_overnight_range, non_eia_overnight_range)

# === Chart: Avg Overnight Range % — EIA Wed vs Non-EIA ===
xy_bars(
    title='CL Overnight Range on EIA Wednesdays vs Non-EIA Days',
    category='Overnight Range',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    data_labels=True,
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=3,
    y_axis_label='Avg Overnight Range (% of Open)',
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='EIA Wednesday', color=Color.Blue),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Non-EIA Day', color=Color.Slate)
    ])
)(eia_overnight_range, non_eia_overnight_range)
